headline: Three logos, four greens, and a menu nobody could read from the queue
leak: Each branch had built its own signage. Customers did not recognise the second branch as the same company.
sub: One mark, one green, one menu system read at four metres. The rollout was the job.
steps: One system, tested at queue distance.
miss: The new cup added a cost nobody had budgeted. Branches used old stock for a quarter.
